plugins.name: Tourne Notes
plugins.author: Tourne (from Noctalia's Notes)
plugins.description: Markdown notes in a side panel: pictures pasted or dropped in, a preview with tick-off checklists, search, and a trash you can restore from.

plugins.name: Wallpaper Carousel
plugins.author: Tourne (from motor-dev's Wallpaper Carousel)
plugins.description: Browse your wallpaper folder as a carousel and set one with a click.

plugins.name: Process List
plugins.author: Tourne (from Mithgroth's Process List)
plugins.description: Live processes with CPU and memory: grouped by program, sorted any way, apps or Windows' own, and an End button.

plugins.name: dGPU Sleep Monitor
plugins.author: Tourne (idea from xantrk's dGPU Sleep Monitor)
plugins.description: Shows whether the graphics card is awake (D0) or asleep (D3), and the battery's draw in watts.

plugins.name: Power Modes
plugins.author: Tourne (idea from psyreactor's Alienware Command Center)
plugins.description: Windows' power mode, power plan and CPU turbo from the bar, the way AWCC switches thermal modes.

plugins.name: Screen Recorder
plugins.author: Tourne (from YoungJurry's Screen Recorder YS)
plugins.description: Record a screen with ffmpeg from the bar: frame rate, quality, size, encoder (CPU or NVIDIA, AMD, Intel), cursor, the PC's sound, a microphone, a countdown.

plugins.name: Timer
plugins.author: Tourne (from hthienloc's Timer)
plugins.description: A countdown on the bar: preset minutes, your own, pause, a sound and a notification at the end, and an optional lock, sleep or shut down.

plugins.name: Hydrate
plugins.author: Tourne (from hthienloc's Hydrate)
plugins.description: A water reminder on the bar: it changes when it's time to drink, right click logs a cup, and the panel shows today's progress.

plugins.name: Caffeine
plugins.author: Tourne (after the DMS Caffeine plugins)
plugins.description: Keeps the PC (and the screen) awake for 5 minutes up to as long as you like. Click the cup to start or stop; right-click to pick how long.

plugins.name: Power Menu
plugins.author: Tourne (after JDKamalakar's Fullscreen Power Menu)
plugins.description: A full-screen power menu over a blurred, dimmed desktop: big buttons for lock, sleep, hibernate, sign out, restart and shut down, with the keyboard or the mouse.

plugins.name: Control Center
plugins.author: Tourne
plugins.description: Every plugin's bar button as a tile in one panel: click a tile as you'd click its button, right-click for its own menu.

plugins.name: Alienware Command Center
plugins.author: Tourne (after psyreactor's Alienware Command Center)
plugins.description: Thermal modes, G-Mode and fan boosts of an Alienware PC through its own firmware interface; set the administrator helper up once and it never asks again.

plugins.name: GMK87
plugins.author: Tourne
plugins.description: Your Zuoya GMK87: backlight effect, colour, brightness and speed (also through its 2.4 GHz dongle), and with its cable in, the screen's pictures and GIFs, its clock and its own settings.

plugins.name: Take a Break
plugins.author: Tourne (from hthienloc's Take a Break)
plugins.description: Short eye breaks and longer stretch breaks on a cycle, a heads-up first, a break screen with a countdown, and no breaks over games or full-screen video.

plugins.name: Breathing
plugins.author: Tourne (from hthienloc's Breathing)
plugins.description: Guided breathing in a panel: six techniques, a circle that grows and shrinks with each phase, and a chime between phases.

plugins.name: Kaomoji Picker
plugins.author: Tourne (from hthienloc's Kaomoji Picker)
plugins.description: Search about 3,200 kaomoji by mood or tag and copy one with a click.

plugins.name: Keystrokes
plugins.author: Tourne (from Tz-slayer's Keystrokes and hthienloc's Screenkey)
plugins.description: A bar button that shows or hides the keycaps on screen (Studio > Keystrokes): the keys you press and the clicks you make, for screencasts and demos. Right click: its settings.

plugins.name: Typing Sounds
plugins.author: Tourne (idea from hthienloc's Typing Sounds)
plugins.description: A click for every key you press, like a mechanical keyboard or a typewriter. Made by the plugin, nothing downloaded. Only that a key went down reaches it, never which key.

plugins.name: Test Notifications
plugins.author: Tourne
plugins.description: A bar button that sends test notifications: real ones, shown as Tourne's pop-ups and kept in the notification centre. Right-click it for how many, how urgent, the words, and your phone too through an ntfy topic.

plugins.name: Bongo Cat
plugins.author: Tourne (idea from hthienloc's Bongo Cat)
plugins.description: A cat on the bar that drums its paws as you type and click. Only that a key went down reaches it, never which key.

plugins.name: Activate Watermark
plugins.author: Tourne (idea from hthienloc's Activate Linux)
plugins.description: The "Activate Windows" watermark on your desktop, with your own words, faint in the corner. Drawn once; nothing runs after.

plugins.name: Desktop Widget Toggle
plugins.author: Tourne (idea from hthienloc's Desktop Widget Toggle)
plugins.description: A bar button that hides every plugin's desktop widgets and shows them again.

plugins.name: Display Profiles
plugins.author: Tourne (idea from hthienloc's Niri Display Settings)
plugins.description: Screens' resolution and refresh rate from the launcher (dp): each screen's modes, and profiles that set every screen at once.

plugins.name: Game Launcher
plugins.author: Tourne (idea from hthienloc's Lutris Launcher)
plugins.description: Your Steam and Epic games in the launcher (g): Enter starts one through its store. Read from this PC; nothing goes online.

plugins.name: Keybind Guide
plugins.author: Tourne (from kenn's Keybind Cheatsheet for Noctalia)
plugins.description: Every key Tourne takes on one searchable sheet: your binds (grouped by their # headings and key modes, numbered ones as one row), Tourne's own hotkeys and the plugins'. Hide rows or rename them; nothing runs until it opens.

plugins.name: Emoji Picker
plugins.author: Tourne (from hthienloc's Emoji Picker (idea only; its data is GPL, so the list here is Unicode's own))
plugins.description: Search every Unicode emoji by name or group and copy one with a click.

plugins.name: IP Indicator
plugins.author: Tourne (from hthienloc's IP Indicator)
plugins.description: Your public IP, country and provider on the bar, a VPN check, the round trip time, and your local addresses. Middle click hides the IP.

plugins.name: Media Downloader
plugins.author: Tourne (from hthienloc's Media Downloader)
plugins.description: Download video or sound from a web link with yt-dlp: format, size, SponsorBlock, cover art and tags, a speed limit, a queue with progress.

plugins.name: OCR Scanner
plugins.author: Tourne (idea from hthienloc's OCR Scanner)
plugins.description: Turn text in a picture into text you can paste: snip part of the screen, or read the picture on the clipboard or a file, with Tesseract. Keeps a history.

plugins.name: Ambient Sounds
plugins.author: Tourne (idea from hthienloc's Ambient Sounds)
plugins.description: Mix background sounds for focus or sleep: white, pink and brown noise built in, plus your own sound files, each with its own volume, saved mixes and a sleep timer.

plugins.name: Tourne'Table Panel
plugins.author: Tourne
plugins.description: A bar button for Tourne'Table's panel: click to show or hide the visualizer's window, right click to keep it on top. Set Tourne'Table's Place In to Panel first.

plugins.name: Syncthing
plugins.author: Tourne (from Marco Ziliani's Syncthing)
plugins.description: Syncthing on the bar: sync state and progress, a panel to pause, resume and rescan folders and devices, notifications, and a desktop card.

needs.label: Syncthing's config.xml (its address and API key)

plugins.name: Wallpaper Depth
plugins.author: Tourne (from Noctalia's Wallpaper Depth)
plugins.description: Depth masks made on your PC from each wallpaper (Depth Anything V2 in Python), so desktop widgets pass behind the scenery's foreground.

plugins.name: Discord Voice
plugins.author: Tourne (from raycursive's Discord Voice)
plugins.description: Discord's voice call on the bar and in a panel: who's in it and speaking, mute, deafen, volumes, latency, saved channels.

plugins.name: Git Companion
plugins.author: Tourne (from thomas-philippot's Git Companion)
plugins.description: Your pull requests, merge requests and issues on GitHub, GitLab or Gitea from the bar, through gh, glab or tea.

plugins.name: Screen Toolkit
plugins.author: Tourne (from alexander's Screen Toolkit)
plugins.description: Screen tools: colour picker, OCR, QR, palette, Google Lens, markup, measure, recording (ffmpeg) and image sharing.

needs.label: tesseract, magick, zbarimg, curl, ffmpeg, ffprobe, trans, mspaint, paintdotnet, krita, gimp, gimp-2.10, gimp-3, gimp-3.0, pinta, ksnip

plugins.name: Claude Cockpit
plugins.author: Tourne (from nightwatch75's Claude Cockpit)
plugins.description: Live Claude Code sessions and usage on the bar; manage sessions, skills and mods, edit CLAUDE.md files.

needs.label: Claude Code's files, with your login token for the usage query
your user folder, to find CLAUDE.md files
Claude Code sessions and skill folders
